verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
From eternity, Lord You dreamed of me
From eternity, You Loved me completely

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
I want my heart to burn within me
I want to love You like You loved me
I want my heart to burn within me
Awaken love

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Waters cannot quench love
Floods cannot drown it
Love is strong as death
As jealous as the grave

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
This was the joy set before You
That You would have my heart forever

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
The same love that You had for Your Son
Burn it in my heart until we are one

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
It's the joy of being love sick
The pleasures of loving You
